source_evidence: The hypothesis is expressed in the current implementation: src/flic.cpp:988-996 (trans switch, opened at src/flic.cpp:962) and src/flic.cpp:1023-1031 (opaque switch, opened at src/flic.cpp:999) spell the FLI subchunk skip labels as explicit stacked case entries (4, 0xb, 0xc, 0x12) whose goto lands on the labeled default arm, so the four skip cases and out-of-range share one fseek(file_, size - 6, SEEK_CUR) body in both switches - exactly the image's wide table plus single shared body, superseding the finding's 'no spelling among those measured' caveat.

The relevant implementation is Flic::decode_chunk (entity-23ce21fb8d6ccb00696c7c63198670b5c3c3fa3a358a33d0f8e86994f46afd28, src/flic.cpp:899-1039); its source note at src/flic.cpp:918-936 records that this goto-into-labeled-default shape is the only measured spelling keeping the image's wide dispatch span [4,0x12] with six handler slots (slot0 = slot5 = the shared skip body) and the index table [0,5,5,1,5,5,5,0,0,2,5,3,4,5,0] byte-for-byte, arm order 7, 0xF, 0xD, 0x10, with code-to-ret 541 equal to the recorded extent.

Fresh diagnostics corroborate the structure: the referenced /diagnostics/check/report/candidate/checks/binary/functions value in request sha256 7add99df64a06d9d14d6df5937dd9e6ac43904f69a26dbeb3fb9a61019a44676 shows decode_chunk under /c /O2 /Gy /GR- /GX /Z7 emitting two six-pointer handler tables whose relocations bind slot0 and slot5 of each table ($L49949/$L49950 and $L49951/$L49952 groups) to the single shared $skip2$47987 target at 0x0062AEA1, matching the image's decoded tables at 0x0062AEF0-0x0062AF38.

This incorporation is not resolution, acceptance or a byte proof: the same fresh result keeps boundary fail for decode_chunk (candidate 624 vs original_size 541, candidate_relocations_outside_original [544,548,...,604]) because VC6 emits the jump tables inside the function COMDAT while the recorded 0x0062ACD0-0x0062AEED extent stops at the ret; that residual placement/policy conflict is the separate still-pending finding worker-05b223693afb4b57ad6cce91a7de8623 and is neither resolved nor waived by this decision.
